name: ember
description: Your watch's ideas in Flash: search them, read them, add to them.

settings.label: Token
settings.help: Leave empty to use the one `ember token --save` kept on this computer.

commands.name: ember
commands.description: ask about your ideas, as /ember what did I think about the engine this week

tools.name: ember_search
tools.description: Search the user's Ember notes: ideas they said to their watch, and notes saved for them. By words (any order, the start of a word will do), time, tag and source. With no query, the newest. Best matches first.

query.description: Words to look for. Leave out for the newest.

since.description: Made at or after this. An ISO date or time (2026-10-21), or how long ago: 24h, 7d, 2w, 3m.

until.description: Made before this. An ISO date or time (2026-10-21), or how long ago: 24h, 7d, 2w, 3m.

source.description: Only from here: watch, cli, flash or api.

limit.description: At most this many, up to 100. 20 unless set.

tools.name: ember_note
tools.description: One Ember note, whole, by its id from ember_search.

tools.name: ember_tags
tools.description: Every tag in use in Ember, with how many notes have it.

tools.name: ember_save
tools.description: Save a new note to Ember for the user. #hashtags in the text become tags too.

tools.name: ember_change
tools.description: Change an Ember note: text replaces its text, tags replaces every tag, add_tags and remove_tags change some.

tools.name: ember_delete
tools.description: Delete an Ember note and its recording. It cannot be undone.
